REPLAY: Burnham, Von der Leyen hail 'turning point' in EU-UK relations
Issued on: Modified:

British Prime Minister Andy Burnham hailed a "landmark" deal with the European Union on Friday, as the two sides sealed pacts on food exports, emissions-trading schemes and youth mobility at a summit in Brussels. EU chief Ursula von der Leyen welcomed a "turning point" in ties with Britain following Brexit. Watch our replay.
